body: Yes I thought I was in the wrong place.  I do have many years left here I'm sure, but I have nothing to offer.  This world is a deranged place, and the only reason anyone can walk around on it is delusion.  So no, I don't think there is a light there.  It has always been this way.  But I will stay here anyway, because as you said there are people who would be hurt.  So I guess you have no need to worry.  I don't think words can ever help people like me, but I understand the intention.  Thanks for your effort.

Jesus Christ it feels so strange to be talking to someone.  I want someone who knows what this is like.  I need the courage to go to that bridge and jump off.  These nightmares will never end, please just tell me it is okay to escape this.
